A Hunter's Calling#000.src: With so much of the active army dead, dying, and corrupted, {p} fell within the day.
A Hunter's Calling#000.dst: 現役部隊死的死、傷的傷，還有已經腐敗的，{p} 當天就淪陷了。

A Hunter's Calling#001.src: After the two soldiers were slain in battle, {p} crumbled.
A Hunter's Calling#001.dst: 那兩名士兵戰死之後，{p} 就垮了。

A Hunter's Calling#002.src: You have been made for a single purpose, peon. The wizard, Theorick, is endangering our cause.
A Hunter's Calling#002.dst: 你被造出來只為了一件事，小嘍囉。那個叫 Theorick 的法師正在妨礙我們的大業。

A Hunter's Calling#003.src: The corruptive influence will spread. I will see this place desolate.
A Hunter's Calling#003.dst: 腐敗會繼續蔓延。我要親眼看著這裡化為荒土。

A Hunter's Calling#004.src: I will demolish this town. Their army will fall before us.
A Hunter's Calling#004.dst: 我要夷平這座城鎮。他們的軍隊會倒在我們腳下。

A Hunter's Calling#005.src: ...Fool. Run while you have the chance.
A Hunter's Calling#005.dst: ……蠢貨。還跑得掉的時候就快跑。

A Hunter's Calling#006.src: Move faster. It will notice your presence soon.
A Hunter's Calling#006.dst: 動作快。他很快就會察覺到你的存在。

A Hunter's Calling#007.src: You need to catch Maxie before he reaches the war scene.
A Hunter's Calling#007.dst: 你得在 Maxie 抵達戰場之前追上他。

A Hunter's Calling#009.src: ...and the Corkians, blindsided by the Factory's reactivation, were purged by metal and electricity.
A Hunter's Calling#009.dst: ……而 Corkian 被工廠的重新啟動打了個措手不及，在鋼鐵與電流之下慘遭肅清。

A Hunter's Calling#010.src: Explore the deepest part of the Silent Expanse
A Hunter's Calling#010.dst: 探索 Silent Expanse 的最深處

A Hunter's Calling#012.src: ...you arrive. You search... To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#012.dst: ……你抵達了。你在尋找……為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#013.src: You wonder. What do we speak of? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#013.dst: 你困惑。我們在說什麼？為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#014.src: You panic. We know you. How? We can provide no answer.
A Hunter's Calling#014.dst: 你驚慌。我們認得你。如何認得？我們給不出答案。

A Hunter's Calling#015.src: For answers... You search. To an end you seek. May we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#015.dst: 為了答案……你尋找。為了你追求的一個終結。我們可否為你提供一個終結？

A Hunter's Calling#016.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.
A Hunter's Calling#016.dst: 被圍困的起源。若要終結，必先開始。

A Hunter's Calling#017.src: You anger. Viewing needless destruction. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#017.dst: 你憤怒。目睹了不必要的毀滅。為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#018.src: You distrust. We are dark. Are we? You believe it so.
A Hunter's Calling#018.dst: 你不信任。我們是黑暗的。是嗎？你如此相信。

A Hunter's Calling#019.src: You prepare. You would attack us. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#019.dst: 你戒備。你想攻擊我們。為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#020.src: There is no end. Of what you wish, there is none. But may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#020.dst: 沒有終結。你所盼望的那種，一個也沒有。但我們可否為你提供一個終結？

A Hunter's Calling#021.src: ???: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning...to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#021.dst: ???: 不義者尋求它。高潔者藏起它。尋求答案的人找到了更多問題。另一個開始……通向一個新的終結。

A Hunter's Calling#022.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#022.dst: 不義者尋求它。高潔者藏起它。尋求答案的人找到了更多問題。另一個開始……通向一個新的終結。

A Hunter's Calling#023.src: Hey, little miss. Don't go spacing out on me like that.
A Hunter's Calling#023.dst: 嘿，小姑娘。別在我面前發起呆來。
A Hunter's Calling#023.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#024.src: Now that you're acquainted with the new laws we'll want to introduce, I've got a job for you to do.
A Hunter's Calling#024.dst: 既然你已經知道我們想推的新法條了，我有件差事要你去辦。
A Hunter's Calling#024.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#025.src: The current mayor is human. He'll inevitably veto the laws. The deputy on the other hand, is a villager, and on our side. See what I'm getting at.
A Hunter's Calling#025.dst: 現任鎮長是人類。他遲早會否決那些法條。副鎮長就不一樣了，是村民，而且站在我們這邊。你懂我的意思吧。
A Hunter's Calling#025.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#026.src: Another employee has already been sent out to get things started. He'll know what you need to do, so meet up with him, would you?
A Hunter's Calling#026.dst: 另一名員工已經先過去打點了。他知道你該做什麼，去跟他會合，好嗎？
A Hunter's Calling#026.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#027.src: Head to town and get further information from the employee at {~}, {~}.
A Hunter's Calling#027.dst: 前往鎮上，向 {~}, {~} 的員工取得進一步的情報。

A Hunter's Calling#028.src: Oh, yeah I saw the mayor not too long ago.
A Hunter's Calling#028.dst: 噢，對，我不久前才看到鎮長。
A Hunter's Calling#028.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#029.src: He was headed towards the bank. Why're you wondering, miss Villager?
A Hunter's Calling#029.dst: 他往銀行的方向去了。你問這個做什麼，村民小姐？
A Hunter's Calling#029.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#030.src: You are here for the job, aren't you? I have to apologize. It's going to be trickier than I'd wanted for you.
A Hunter's Calling#030.dst: 你是為了那件差事來的吧？我得先道個歉。事情會比我原本預想的還棘手。
A Hunter's Calling#030.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#031.src: So our mission is to assassinate the mayor. Amadel told you about the laws. We have a puppet in the running who'll rubberstamp them.
A Hunter's Calling#031.dst: 我們的任務是暗殺鎮長。Amadel 跟你說過那些法條了。我們有個傀儡在候選名單上，會照單全收地蓋章。
A Hunter's Calling#031.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#032.src: I've got a trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#032.dst: 我在銀行裡設了一個陷阱。過程實在太麻煩了，不過總算成了。你的工作是觸發那個陷阱。
A Hunter's Calling#032.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#033.src: I've got the trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#033.dst: 我在銀行裡設了一個陷阱。過程實在太麻煩了，不過總算成了。你的工作是觸發那個陷阱。
A Hunter's Calling#033.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#034.src: Climb up the tree behind me and look through the window, you should be able to see it from there.
A Hunter's Calling#034.dst: 爬上我後面那棵樹，從窗戶往裡看，你應該從那裡就看得到。
A Hunter's Calling#034.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#035.src: Climb up the tree and look through the window.

A Hunter's Calling#036.src: Can you see the mayor? I had to stay totally out of sight while setting this all up, so...
A Hunter's Calling#036.dst: 你看到鎮長了嗎？我布置這一切的時候得完全躲著不被看見，所以……
A Hunter's Calling#036.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#037.src: ...the only way to get to the trap is to jump across the hanging lamps in the ceiling.
A Hunter's Calling#037.dst: ……要碰到那個陷阱，唯一的辦法是從天花板上那排吊燈跳過去。
A Hunter's Calling#037.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#038.src: You can absolutely not be spotted. The way up to the ceiling is on the opposite side of the bank. Just keep on walking past the guards, play it cool.
A Hunter's Calling#038.dst: 你絕對不能被發現。上天花板的路在銀行的另一側。就這樣走過那些衛兵旁邊，裝作沒事。
A Hunter's Calling#038.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#039.src: No one enters when the mayor is doing his errands, sorry. You'll have to wait for your transaction.
A Hunter's Calling#039.dst: 鎮長辦事的時候不准任何人進入，抱歉。你的交易得等一等。
A Hunter's Calling#039.speaker: Bodyguard

A Hunter's Calling#040.src: Head back to the excavation camp.

A Hunter's Calling#041.src: Quickly, back to the camp. Before we're noticed.
A Hunter's Calling#041.dst: 快，回營地。趁還沒被發現。
A Hunter's Calling#041.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#044.src: Yes sir, everything went smoothly, {u} did a great thing for the company.
A Hunter's Calling#044.dst: 是的長官，一切順利，{u} 為公司做了一件大好事。
A Hunter's Calling#044.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#045.src: We can send in Miss Wuna at any time now, and she'll give us the clearance to start the excavation in a snap.
A Hunter's Calling#045.dst: 我們隨時可以把 Wuna 小姐送進去，她一下子就會批准我們開始挖掘。
A Hunter's Calling#045.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#046.src: ...you rage. Aided the ignoble. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#046.dst: ……你暴怒。助長了卑劣之事。為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#047.src: You misinterpret. What you see... Is it true? How?
A Hunter's Calling#047.dst: 你誤解了。你所看見的……是真的嗎？如何為真？

A Hunter's Calling#048.src: The answer... It will not bring you the end.
A Hunter's Calling#048.dst: 那個答案……它不會為你帶來終結。

A Hunter's Calling#049.src: You see. Yet you do not understand. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#049.dst: 你看見了。然而你並不明白。那麼，我們可否為你提供一個終結？

A Hunter's Calling#050.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.
A Hunter's Calling#050.dst: 殘忍的。仁慈的。自私的。正義的。那個一生都在矛盾中行走的人。那個面對了冰冷永恆的人。走向他的終結。

A Hunter's Calling#052.src: Listen, I understand the discontent, but we must start rationing! The corruption is consuming our arable fields.
A Hunter's Calling#052.dst: 聽著，我明白大家的不滿，但我們必須開始配給了！腐敗正在吞噬我們的耕地。
A Hunter's Calling#052.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#053.src: Who knows if we'll even have water soon? We need to save up as much as we can!
A Hunter's Calling#053.dst: 誰知道我們是不是很快連水都沒有了？我們得盡可能存下來！
A Hunter's Calling#053.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#054.src: Yeah, and what does Theorick have to say on the topic? How will he think of that?
A Hunter's Calling#054.dst: 是啊，那 Theorick 對這件事怎麼說？他會怎麼想？
A Hunter's Calling#054.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#055.src: He will be here shortly to discuss this problem in more detai-
A Hunter's Calling#055.dst: 他很快就會過來，跟大家更詳細地討論這個問——
A Hunter's Calling#055.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#056.src: Everyone, hush and listen to what Kotham is saying!
A Hunter's Calling#056.dst: 各位，安靜，聽 Kotham 說話！
A Hunter's Calling#056.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#057.src: As the mayor said, all of you need to start rationing what you eat and drink. I cannot be here every waking moment!
A Hunter's Calling#057.dst: 就像鎮長說的，你們所有人都得開始節制吃喝。我沒辦法每一刻都待在這裡！
A Hunter's Calling#057.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#058.src: In addition, I've figured something very important out. I'm developing a way to cease the spread of corruption. So I need to concentrate on that.
A Hunter's Calling#058.dst: 另外，我想通了一件非常重要的事。我正在研究一個阻止腐敗擴散的方法。所以我需要專心。
A Hunter's Calling#058.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#060.src: ...someone among you... I can feel a horrendous strength...
A Hunter's Calling#060.dst: ……你們之中有人……我感覺得到一股可怕的力量……
A Hunter's Calling#060.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#061.src: Kotham! Get everyone to safety! NOW! MOVE, GO!
A Hunter's Calling#061.dst: Kotham！把所有人帶到安全的地方！現在！快走，走！
A Hunter's Calling#061.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#062.src: You! Sent by Bak'al, I assume? What, is he too much of a coward to face me himself?
A Hunter's Calling#062.dst: 你！我猜是 Bak'al 派來的？怎麼，他懦弱到不敢自己來面對我？
A Hunter's Calling#062.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#063.src: What purpose do you have for doing this? This destruction is needless! {p} and all of Wynn have suffered enough!
A Hunter's Calling#063.dst: 你這麼做是為了什麼？這場毀滅根本沒有必要！{p} 和整個 Wynn 受的苦已經夠多了！
A Hunter's Calling#063.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#064.src: I'll freeze you solid, just like the rest of the corruption, you foul THING!
A Hunter's Calling#064.dst: 我要把你凍成冰塊，就像其他腐敗物一樣，你這骯髒的東西！
A Hunter's Calling#064.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#066.src: This way, no one else gets hurt. Only one will leave from here alive.
A Hunter's Calling#066.dst: 這樣一來就不會有別人受傷了。只有一個人能活著離開這裡。
A Hunter's Calling#066.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#067.src: ...you fear. Does the dark become you?

A Hunter's Calling#069.src: No. You remain whole. You do not change.
A Hunter's Calling#069.dst: 不。你仍然完整。你並未改變。

A Hunter's Calling#070.src: So, you wonder. To what end? The question brings dread.
A Hunter's Calling#070.dst: 於是你困惑。為了什麼終結？這個問題帶來恐懼。

A Hunter's Calling#071.src: Yet, an end is what you seek. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#071.dst: 然而，終結正是你所追求的。那麼，我們可否為你提供一個終結？

A Hunter's Calling#072.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.
A Hunter's Calling#072.dst: 一個終結，被更多的行動所驅逐。一個終結，降臨於六者。一個終結，屬於傲慢者的篤定。一個終結，屬於這個世界……以某種形式。

A Hunter's Calling#073.src: Enter the Corrupter of World Cave
A Hunter's Calling#073.dst: 進入 Corrupter of World Cave

A Hunter's Calling#074.src: Make your way to the end of the cave.

A Hunter's Calling#075.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.
A Hunter's Calling#075.dst: 回到洞穴上層，弄出一條出路。

A Hunter's Calling#076.src: ...you disbelieve. It was an end. But you are here once more.
A Hunter's Calling#076.dst: ……你不願相信。那曾是一個終結。但你再度來到這裡。

A Hunter's Calling#077.src: How much more? Where next? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#077.dst: 還要多少？下一個在哪裡？為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#078.src: Aiding terrible forces... But is it true? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#078.dst: 助長了可怕的力量……但那是真的嗎？為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#079.src: No. You see possibility. You do not see certainty.
A Hunter's Calling#079.dst: 不。你看見的是可能。你看見的不是必然。

A Hunter's Calling#080.src: You question. To what end, then, and so may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#080.dst: 你質問。那麼，為了什麼終結，而我們可否為你提供一個終結？

A Hunter's Calling#081.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?
A Hunter's Calling#081.dst: 金屬。阻止一個終結。生命。終結，被阻止了。金屬奪走生命、帶來一個終結，真的能阻止更多終結嗎？

A Hunter's Calling#082.src: Ah, here for the job opportunity then, I see. The waiver didn't turn you away, good!
A Hunter's Calling#082.dst: 啊，看來你是為了那個工作機會來的。免責聲明沒把你嚇跑，很好！
A Hunter's Calling#082.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#083.src: Now, to business. Times are tough, as you know, and our Iron Golems are in high demand. However, we've, ah...
A Hunter's Calling#083.dst: 那麼，說正事。如你所知，時局艱難，而我們的鐵魔像需求量很大。然而，我們，呃……
A Hunter's Calling#083.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#084.src: ...experienced a draught of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#084.dst: ……遇上了「志願者」短缺的問題。你的工作相當簡單；就是——咳——說服一些人加入這份事業。
A Hunter's Calling#084.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#085.src: ...experienced a drought of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#085.dst: ……遇上了「志願者」短缺的問題。你的工作相當簡單；就是——咳——說服一些人加入這份事業。
A Hunter's Calling#085.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#086.src: The King of {p} sought help from {p}, the most secure fortress in the province. But help was too late.
A Hunter's Calling#086.dst: {p} 的國王向全行省最堅固的要塞 {p} 求援。但援助來得太遲了。

A Hunter's Calling#087.src: Your attention should be drawn to my peon. Now fall.
A Hunter's Calling#087.dst: 你該注意的是我的走卒。現在，倒下吧。

A Hunter's Calling#088.src: After a villager took over, new laws were put in place. This was the spark Wynnexcavation needed to start their work.
A Hunter's Calling#088.dst: 一名村民掌權之後，頒布了新的法律。這正是 Wynnexcavation 開始動工所需要的契機。

A Hunter's Calling#089.src: He is capable of halting our advance with his damnable ice. Kill him.
A Hunter's Calling#089.dst: 他能用那該死的冰擋住我們的攻勢。殺了他。

A Hunter's Calling#090.src: Three people should be enough for the moment. Look around the swamp for some folks, and lure them over here.
A Hunter's Calling#090.dst: 目前三個人應該就夠了。在沼澤附近找找人，把他們引過來。
A Hunter's Calling#090.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#091.src: I'll stay in here and take care of them when you bring me them. It will absolutely be worth your while, I assure you.
A Hunter's Calling#091.dst: 我會待在這裡，等你把他們帶來就好好照顧他們。我向你保證，這絕對值得。
A Hunter's Calling#091.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#092.src: Trick {~} people to follow you into the iron golem factory.
A Hunter's Calling#092.dst: 騙 {~} 個人跟著你進入鐵魔像工廠。

A Hunter's Calling#093.src: Agh, dang it dang it dang it!! You over there, help me out, would ya??
A Hunter's Calling#093.dst: 啊，可惡可惡可惡！那邊那位，能幫我一下嗎？？
A Hunter's Calling#093.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#094.src: I tripped and fell in this stupid hole, and now there's mud in my eyes that I can't get out!
A Hunter's Calling#094.dst: 我絆倒摔進這個爛坑裡，現在眼睛裡都是泥巴，弄不出來！
A Hunter's Calling#094.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#095.src: I need to get home or to some kind of a doctor so I can wash my eyes out with actual clean water.
A Hunter's Calling#095.dst: 我得回家，或者找個醫生之類的，用真正乾淨的水把眼睛沖一沖。
A Hunter's Calling#095.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#096.src: Get me to {p} or a doctor or even just a sink!
A Hunter's Calling#096.dst: 帶我去 {p}，或者找個醫生，甚至只要有個水槽也好！
A Hunter's Calling#096.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#097.src: Good job! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#097.dst: 做得好！我們會好好照顧你的。
A Hunter's Calling#097.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#098.src: Well done! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#098.dst: 做得好！我們會好好照顧你的。
A Hunter's Calling#098.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#099.src: Oh, ah...heehee, heya cutie.. Whatcha doin' all the way out here?
A Hunter's Calling#099.dst: 噢，啊……嘻嘻，嗨啊小可愛……你跑到這麼遠的地方做什麼呀？
A Hunter's Calling#099.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#100.src: Just exploring, huh? I bet someone like you could use someone to...y'know, spend some time with...
A Hunter's Calling#100.dst: 只是在探險？我敢說像你這樣的人，需要有個人……你知道的，陪你打發時間……
A Hunter's Calling#100.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#101.src: ...guess you're not interested? Oh...sorry if I came off as creepy. I'm just...really lonely, is all.
A Hunter's Calling#101.dst: ……看來你沒興趣？噢……如果我讓你覺得毛毛的，抱歉。我只是……真的很寂寞而已。
A Hunter's Calling#101.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#102.src: W-wait, those are...for me? Oh, you shouldn't have, I'm so happy!
A Hunter's Calling#102.dst: 等、等等，那些是……給我的？噢，你太客氣了，我好開心！
A Hunter's Calling#102.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#103.src: You want to take me out on a date? R-Really? You'll give me a chance? Yes, of course!
A Hunter's Calling#103.dst: 你想約我出去？真、真的嗎？你願意給我一個機會？好，我當然願意！
A Hunter's Calling#103.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#104.src: Lead the way, please! I can't wait to see where we're headed!
A Hunter's Calling#104.dst: 請帶路！我等不及想看看我們要去哪裡了！
A Hunter's Calling#104.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#105.src: A bit of spare change, for an old man out of work?
A Hunter's Calling#105.dst: 給個零錢吧，可憐可憐一個沒工作的老頭？
A Hunter's Calling#105.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#106.src: This decay's made me terribly sick. I still have a family to feed... Any amount will help.
A Hunter's Calling#106.dst: 這場衰敗把我害得病得很重。我還有一家人要養……多少都好。
A Hunter's Calling#106.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#107.src: I'll take care of this homeless old man.
A Hunter's Calling#107.dst: 這個無家可歸的老頭交給我來照顧。
A Hunter's Calling#107.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#108.src: Good job, let us get down to my lab.
A Hunter's Calling#108.dst: 做得好，我們下去我的實驗室吧。
A Hunter's Calling#108.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#109.src: Make your way through the factory.

A Hunter's Calling#110.src: Flawless work! I daresay these are some of our best work yet, and it's thanks to you.
A Hunter's Calling#110.dst: 完美無瑕！我敢說這幾具是我們至今最好的作品，而這都要感謝你。
A Hunter's Calling#110.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#111.src: Go on, step closer! You've done a wonderful service here. Examine the fruits of your labor!
A Hunter's Calling#111.dst: 來，靠近一點！你在這裡立下了了不起的功勞。來看看你努力的成果。
A Hunter's Calling#111.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#112.src: Look into their eyes, it's almost like you can see the person they once were. Intriguing, isn't-
A Hunter's Calling#112.dst: 看看他們的眼睛，幾乎能看見他們曾經是什麼樣的人。很有意思，不是——
A Hunter's Calling#112.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#113.src: Hah! This one seems quite fond of you! Want to take it home as a bonus to your payment?
A Hunter's Calling#113.dst: 哈！這一具看起來挺喜歡你的！要不要把他帶回家，當作報酬之外的紅利？
A Hunter's Calling#113.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#114.src: ...you resign yourself. You believe you will never find the answers you seek.
A Hunter's Calling#114.dst: ……你放棄了。你相信自己永遠找不到你所追尋的答案。

A Hunter's Calling#115.src: You see the ends... To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#115.dst: 你看見了那些終結……為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#116.src: They are not yours. What is their purpose?
A Hunter's Calling#116.dst: 它們不屬於你。它們的目的是什麼？

A Hunter's Calling#117.src: You do not understand. But you must see. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#117.dst: 你並不明白。但你必須看見。那麼，我們可否為你提供一個終結？

A Hunter's Calling#118.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.
A Hunter's Calling#118.dst: 一個家園，被入侵。一個社會，正在崩解。人民，正在挨餓。憂心者，無能為力。火焰，正在升起。一個你意料之外的終結。

A Hunter's Calling#119.src: Our king has requested the removal of the slum folk.
A Hunter's Calling#119.dst: 我們的國王要求把貧民窟那些人清走。
A Hunter's Calling#119.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#120.src: He wants to clean up their tunnels and build more residences. Please, go tell those hooligans to get out of our city.
A Hunter's Calling#120.dst: 他想把他們的地道整理乾淨，蓋更多住宅。請去告訴那些混混，離開我們的城市。
A Hunter's Calling#120.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#121.src: I'll be waiting here for your return.
A Hunter's Calling#121.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#122.src: Tell the hooligans in the slums about the eviction notice.
A Hunter's Calling#122.dst: 把驅逐通知告訴貧民窟裡的那群流氓。

A Hunter's Calling#123.src: A King's messenger, hm? What are your kind doing here?
A Hunter's Calling#123.dst: 國王的信使，嗯？你們這種人來這裡做什麼？
A Hunter's Calling#123.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#124.src: Wait, eviction?! You can't possibly be serious! I understand orders are orders, but these are peoples' lives!
A Hunter's Calling#124.dst: 等等，驅離？！你不可能是認真的吧！我明白命令就是命令，但這些是活生生的人命！
A Hunter's Calling#124.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#125.src: This is the only time the king has ever bothered even acknowledging our existence, and he wants to fling us onto the streets?
A Hunter's Calling#125.dst: 這是國王第一次肯承認我們的存在，而他居然想把我們丟到街上？
A Hunter's Calling#125.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#126.src: We will not leave, simple as that. You'd better get out before someone lays you out for coming here.
A Hunter's Calling#126.dst: 我們不會走的，就這麼簡單。你最好快走，免得有人看你跑來這裡不順眼，把你放倒。
A Hunter's Calling#126.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#127.src: Return to the advisor for what to do next.
A Hunter's Calling#127.dst: 回去找顧問，問接下來該怎麼做。

A Hunter's Calling#128.src: As expected... Well, the King's orders are orders. They must be followed, but...
A Hunter's Calling#128.dst: 不出所料……唉，國王的命令就是命令。必須遵從，但是……
A Hunter's Calling#128.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#129.src: Good God, he wants to cave it in?! Explosives, dynamite? What's the meaning of all this?!
A Hunter's Calling#129.dst: 老天，他想把那裡炸塌？！炸藥、火藥？這一切到底是什麼意思？！
A Hunter's Calling#129.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#130.src: I... here. At least inform them before you set off the explosives that you're doing this, please...
A Hunter's Calling#130.dst: 我……好吧。至少在你引爆之前先告訴他們你要這麼做，拜託……
A Hunter's Calling#130.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#131.src: Head deep inside the slums and blow it up.

A Hunter's Calling#132.src: ...once again. You wonder. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#132.dst: ……又一次。你困惑。為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#133.src: The question taunts you. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#133.dst: 這個問題在嘲弄你。為了什麼終結？

A Hunter's Calling#134.src: Your soul. We see your soul. Conflicted.
A Hunter's Calling#134.dst: 你的靈魂。我們看見你的靈魂。矛盾著。

A Hunter's Calling#135.src: You panic. We do not taint it. We do not darken it.
A Hunter's Calling#135.dst: 你驚慌。我們沒有玷污它。我們沒有使它變暗。

A Hunter's Calling#136.src: But to what end, you ask. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#136.dst: 你問，但為了什麼終結？那麼，我們可否為你提供一個終結？

A Hunter's Calling#137.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
A Hunter's Calling#137.dst: 金屬。生命。一個新的地方……不以其一獻祭其二。始終彼此猜疑。齒輪鳴響之時，緊繃隨之而來。

A Hunter's Calling#138.src: AH, GOOD. I LIKE THE LOOKS OF THIS ONE. I WILL HAVE TO THANK WHOEVER MADE THIS MECH.
A Hunter's Calling#138.dst: 啊，很好。我喜歡這一具的外觀。我得感謝造出這具機兵的人。
A Hunter's Calling#138.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#139.src: MECH PL-{~}Y. CAN YOU UNDERSTAND ME? ARE YOUR AUDIO RECEPTORS FUNCTIONAL? YES? GOOD.
A Hunter's Calling#139.dst: 機兵 PL-{~}Y。你聽得懂我說話嗎？你的聲音接收器功能正常嗎？是？很好。
A Hunter's Calling#139.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#140.src: I WILL GIVE YOU YOUR PURPOSE. I CANNOT BELIEVE IT HAS COME TO THIS POINT. BUT AFTER THAT HUMAN DESTROYED OUR FACILITY...
A Hunter's Calling#140.dst: 我將賦予你目的。我無法相信事情竟走到了這一步。但自從那個人類摧毀了我們的設施之後……
A Hunter's Calling#140.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#141.src: IT WAS A GOOD THING I HAD BACKUP CORES PREPARED. MY SARCASTIC STATEMENTS MOST LIKELY TRICKED THE HUMAN INTO THINKING THEY DESTROYED ME FULLY.
A Hunter's Calling#141.dst: 幸好我事先準備了備用核心。我那些諷刺的發言，很可能讓那個人類以為他們已經徹底摧毀了我。
A Hunter's Calling#141.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#142.src: AFTER SOME INVESTIGATION, IT CAME TO LIGHT THAT THE AVOS AIDED THE HUMANS. I HONESTLY COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY.
A Hunter's Calling#142.dst: 經過一番調查，事情明朗了: Avos 協助了人類。老實說我無法理解為什麼。
A Hunter's Calling#142.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#143.src: I CANNOT COMPUTE ANY OTHER POSSIBLE INTERPRETATION OF MY ORDER TO DESTROY THE HIGHEST THREATS AT THIS POINT.
A Hunter's Calling#143.dst: 對於「摧毀最高等級的威脅」這道命令，我此刻無法運算出任何其他可能的解讀。
A Hunter's Calling#143.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#144.src: BOTH THE AVOS AND HUMANS ARE INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS. I MEAN, HAVE YOU- WAIT. YOU WOULD NOT HAVE SEEN LEGENDARY ISLAND.
A Hunter's Calling#144.dst: Avos 與人類都極度危險。話說，你有沒有——等等。你不可能見過 Legendary Island。
A Hunter's Calling#144.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#145.src: JUST KNOW THAT THEY'RE BOTH CRAZY. IF I AM TO FINISH MY PROGRAMMED ORDERS, BOTH OF THEM MUST BE DESTROYED, HOWEVER MUCH I MIGHT HATE THE IDEA.
A Hunter's Calling#145.dst: 你只要知道他們兩邊都瘋了。若要完成我被寫入的命令，兩者都必須被摧毀，無論我多麼厭惡這個想法。
A Hunter's Calling#145.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#146.src: IT IS YOUR JOB TO CREATE DISTRUST BETWEEN THEM. MAKE SURE YOU AREN'T SEEN. THE AVOS ARE ALREADY SKEPTICAL OF THE CORKIANS.
A Hunter's Calling#146.dst: 你的工作是在他們之間製造猜疑，務必不要被看見。Avos 本來就對 Corkian 存疑。
A Hunter's Calling#146.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#147.src: AND THE HUMANS WERE IDIOTIC ENOUGH TO KEEP A CATAPULT AIMED AT THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEIR STUPIDITY.
A Hunter's Calling#147.dst: 而人類蠢到把一台投石機一直對著 Avos 的聚落。善用他們的愚蠢。
A Hunter's Calling#147.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#148.src: Find a rock to launch into the Avos territory and a battery to activate the catapult.
A Hunter's Calling#148.dst: 找一塊石頭發射到 Avos 的領地，並找一顆電池啟動投石機。

A Hunter's Calling#149.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: REALLY, WHO'S SO STUPID AS TO LEAVE A CATAPULT AIMED AT YOUR ALLIES?
A Hunter's Calling#149.dst: 開始傳輸: 說真的，誰會蠢到把投石機一直對著自己的盟友？
A Hunter's Calling#149.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#150.src: Bzzt... Hello World.NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
A Hunter's Calling#150.dst: 嗶滋……Hello World.已登錄新敵人: AVOS。執行攻擊協定……喀。
A Hunter's Calling#150.speaker: Corkus Guard

A Hunter's Calling#151.src: SURELY THE AVOS' NATURAL PREFERENCE FOR TREBUCHETS WILL SPARK CONFLICT. IN ADDITION TO THE STONE YOU WILL BE LOBBING THROUGH THEIR WALLS.
A Hunter's Calling#151.dst: Avos 天生偏好配重投石機，光是這點就足以引發衝突。再加上你即將砸穿他們牆壁的那塊石頭。
A Hunter's Calling#151.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#152.dst: 傳輸暫停: 掃描區域中……
A Hunter's Calling#152.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#154.src: RESUME TRANSMISSION: YOU WILL TAKE STONE FROM THIS AREA. IT IS LIKELY TO SHATTER AND INFLICT MORE COLLATERAL DAMAGE.
A Hunter's Calling#154.dst: 恢復傳輸: 你將從這個區域取走石塊。它很可能碎裂，造成更多的附帶損害。
A Hunter's Calling#154.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#155.src: AND SOMEHOW, THEY MADE A WOODEN CATAPULT ACTIVATE ONLY THROUGH ELECTROMAGIC. YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO ACTIVATE IT OF YOUR OWN ACCORD.
A Hunter's Calling#155.dst: 而且不知怎麼的，他們造了一台只能靠電魔法啟動的木製投石機。你應該有辦法自行啟動它。
A Hunter's Calling#155.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#156.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Factory base.
A Hunter's Calling#156.dst: 結束傳輸。機兵 PL-{~}Y。完成目標之後，我會把你送回工廠基地。
A Hunter's Calling#156.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#157.src: I'm... in shock. We aid them in destroying their factory, and...
A Hunter's Calling#157.dst: 我……太震驚了。我們幫他們摧毀了自己的工廠，結果……
A Hunter's Calling#157.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#158.src: Round up the defenses and sharpen the spears. There is no excuse for this.
A Hunter's Calling#158.dst: 整頓防務，把長矛磨利。這種事沒有任何藉口可言。
A Hunter's Calling#158.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#160.src: Chieftain! We noticed the same thing as you did and I promise you, it was not us who did this.
A Hunter's Calling#160.dst: 族長！我們注意到的跟你一樣，我向你保證，這不是我們做的。
A Hunter's Calling#160.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#161.src: Maxie! There is no more 'both sides' here! This is not your people tearing up the earth, this is your people making attempts on our lives!
A Hunter's Calling#161.dst: Maxie！這裡已經沒有「雙方各有道理」了！這不是你的族人在翻動土地，這是你的族人在謀害我們的性命！
A Hunter's Calling#161.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#162.src: No, I swear this wasn't planned! I'm on the city council now! There's got to be another explanation. There's still mechs around, it could have been one of them!
A Hunter's Calling#162.dst: 不，我發誓這不是計畫好的！我現在是市議會的一員了！一定還有別的解釋。附近還有機兵，可能是其中一具幹的！
A Hunter's Calling#162.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#163.src: And what would those monstrosities be taking orders from now? Your factory is shut down, as it ought to be!
A Hunter's Calling#163.dst: 那麼那些怪物現在又是聽誰的命令？你們的工廠已經關閉了，本來就該關！
A Hunter's Calling#163.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#164.src: I'll investigate this myself. There's got to be some other explanation! Please, hold off on the war preparations!
A Hunter's Calling#164.dst: 我會親自去查。一定還有別的解釋！拜託，先暫停備戰！
A Hunter's Calling#164.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#165.src: Steal the Avos totem and activate it outside of {p}
A Hunter's Calling#165.dst: 偷走 Avos 的圖騰，並在 {p} 外面啟動它

A Hunter's Calling#166.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN ALL WE NEEDED TO DO, IF NOT FOR SOMEONE INTERFERING. YOU DID YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#166.dst: 開始傳輸: 要不是有人插手，我們該做的就到此為止了。你的工作完成得很完美，機兵 PL-{~}Y。
A Hunter's Calling#166.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#167.src: BUT THERE WILL BE ANOTHER TASK FOR YOU. IT IS TIME TO MAKE THE AVOS LOOK AS THOUGH THEY ARE ATTACKING.
A Hunter's Calling#167.dst: 但你還有另一項任務。是時候讓 Avos 看起來像是在發動攻擊了。
A Hunter's Calling#167.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#168.src: THERE IS A TOTEM IN THE AVOS CHIEFTAIN'S TENT THAT CAN HARNESS DRUIDIC MAGIC. YOU WILL STEAL IT AND ATTACK CORKUS CITY.
A Hunter's Calling#168.dst: Avos 族長的帳篷裡有一座能駕馭德魯伊魔法的圖騰。你將偷走它，並攻擊 Corkus 城。
A Hunter's Calling#168.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#169.src: YOU WILL BREAK IN, AIDED BY THE TELEPORTATION MECH THAT I AM SENDING THIS MESSAGE THROUGH. DO NOT GET CAUGHT.
A Hunter's Calling#169.dst: 你將闖入，由我用來傳送這則訊息的傳送機兵協助。不要被抓到。
A Hunter's Calling#169.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#170.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Next objective location.
A Hunter's Calling#170.dst: 結束傳輸。機兵 PL-{~}Y。完成目標之後，我會把你送到下一個目標地點。
A Hunter's Calling#170.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#173.src: Sending Mech PL-{~}Y to Next objective location...
A Hunter's Calling#173.dst: 正在將機兵 PL-{~}Y 送往下一個目標地點……
A Hunter's Calling#173.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#174.src: WHAT IS THAT!? THE AVOS ARE ATTACKING?
A Hunter's Calling#174.dst: 那是什麼！？Avos 在攻擊我們？
A Hunter's Calling#174.speaker: Corkus Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#175.src: They listened to me... right? Why's this-
A Hunter's Calling#175.dst: 他們聽進我的話了……對吧？這為什麼會——
A Hunter's Calling#175.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#176.src: What in the world...? That's Avos magic!
A Hunter's Calling#176.dst: 這到底是什麼……？那是 Avos 的魔法！
A Hunter's Calling#176.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#177.src: Why're they attacking us? This is on a way bigger scale than finding grape vines in my laundry machine!
A Hunter's Calling#177.dst: 他們為什麼要攻擊我們？這比在洗衣機裡發現葡萄藤嚴重太多了！
A Hunter's Calling#177.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#178.src: Don't panic! I'll talk to the Chieftain. There's been some kind of mistake here, I'm certain of it!
A Hunter's Calling#178.dst: 別慌！我去跟族長談。這裡一定有什麼誤會，我很確定！
A Hunter's Calling#178.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#179.src: Chief! I thought I asked you to put away the war drums!
A Hunter's Calling#179.dst: 族長！我不是請你把戰鼓收起來了嗎？
A Hunter's Calling#179.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#180.src: We HAVE, Maxie. Do not make accusations upon us, on our own land.
A Hunter's Calling#180.dst: 我們「收了」，Maxie。別在我們自己的土地上指控我們。
A Hunter's Calling#180.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#181.src: {p} was attacked today! A magical root broke through our wall. This is nature magic, an Avos specialty!
A Hunter's Calling#181.dst: {p} 今天遭到攻擊！一條魔法根鬚穿破了我們的牆。這是自然魔法，Avos 的專長！
A Hunter's Calling#181.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#182.src: Hm. Convenient, that one of our prized ceremonial totems has gone missing. You may be right that someone is attempting to cause insurgence.
A Hunter's Calling#182.dst: 唔。真巧，我們一座珍貴的儀式圖騰不見了。你說有人企圖挑起叛亂，或許是對的。
A Hunter's Calling#182.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#183.src: I knew this was some kind of mistake. I'll get to the bottom of this!
A Hunter's Calling#183.dst: 我就知道這是某種誤會！我會把這件事查個水落石出！
A Hunter's Calling#183.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#184.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THERE'S AN ANNOYING WRENCH IN THE WORKS. YOU'VE BEEN DOING YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#184.dst: 開始傳輸: 出現了一個礙事的變數。你的工作一直做得很完美，機兵 PL-{~}Y。
A Hunter's Calling#184.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#185.src: I'VE GOT ONE MORE ORDER FOR YOU THAT SHOULD TIP THINGS OVER THE EDGE. STAND BY FOR TELEPORTATION.
A Hunter's Calling#185.dst: 我還有一道命令要給你，那應該足以讓局勢徹底翻覆。待命，準備傳送。
A Hunter's Calling#185.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#187.src: THERE IS A SET OF STATISTICALLY INFERIOR MECHS BUILT BY THE CORKIANS IN THIS TOWER. I HAVE A SET OF SYSTEMS PROGRAMMED IN THIS DEVICE.
A Hunter's Calling#187.dst: 這座塔裡有一批 Corkian 造的、統計上劣等的機兵，我在這個裝置裡寫好了一套系統。
A Hunter's Calling#187.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#188.src: THIS WILL OVERRIDE THEIR CURRENT PROGRAMMING AND SEND THEM TO ATTACK THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. THEY'LL BE SO DISGUSTED BY THE CORKIAN'S RELENTLESS BRANDING...
A Hunter's Calling#188.dst: 這會覆寫它們目前的程式，讓它們去攻擊 Avos 的聚落。它們會被 Corkian 沒完沒了的品牌行銷噁心得——
A Hunter's Calling#188.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#189.src: NO, I CAN'T EVEN KEEP UP THE SARCASTIC FACADE ANYMORE. THEY'LL ATTACK AND KILL AVOS PEOPLE AND SET THE CIVIL WAR BLAZING. DO YOUR JOB QUICKLY. END TRANSMISSION.
A Hunter's Calling#189.dst: 不，我連裝出諷刺的樣子都撐不下去了。它們會攻擊並殺死 Avos 的人，把內戰點燃。快去做你的工作。結束傳輸。
A Hunter's Calling#189.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#191.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: YOUR JOB IS OVER, MECH PL-{~}Y. I HESITATE TO SAY YOU DID A GOOD JOB, BECAUSE THE JOB WAS ANYTHING BUT GOOD. IT WAS NECESSARY THOUGH.
A Hunter's Calling#191.dst: 開始傳輸: 你的工作結束了，機兵 PL-{~}Y。我很難說你做得好，因為這份工作一點也不好。但它是必要的。
A Hunter's Calling#191.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#192.src: WE WILL BE ABLE TO LET THEM TEAR THEMSELVES TO SHREDS INSTEAD OF GETTING INVOLVED AND SPARKING SUSPICION.
A Hunter's Calling#192.dst: 我們能讓他們自相殘殺，而不必自己介入、引來懷疑。
A Hunter's Calling#192.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#193.src: I HAD WANTED TO FIND A SOLUTION THAT WOULD NOT REQUIRE A FRESH START. IF MY HAND WAS NOT FORCED, PERHAPS. BUT THAT IS IRRELEVANT NOW.
A Hunter's Calling#193.dst: 我原本希望能找到一個不需要重新開始的解法。若我當初沒有被逼到那一步，或許可以。但那已經無關緊要了。
A Hunter's Calling#193.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#194.src: YOU WILL RETURN TO THE FACTORY WITH THE TELEPORTATION MECH AND REMAIN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE-
A Hunter's Calling#194.dst: 你將與傳送機兵一同返回工廠，並待命至另行通知——
A Hunter's Calling#194.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#195.src: I knew it! It was such a longshot, but I knew the Factory still had to be at large! And now I have evidence to prove it, too!
A Hunter's Calling#195.dst: 我就知道！這根本是碰運氣，但我就知道工廠一定還在運作！而且現在我還有證據可以證明！
A Hunter's Calling#195.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#196.src: This time we'll make sure you won't get another chance. I'll tell everyone what happened, and then we'll tear that factory down at the foundations!
A Hunter's Calling#196.dst: 這一次我們會確保你們沒有下一次機會。我會把發生的事告訴所有人，然後我們會把那座工廠連地基一起拆掉！
A Hunter's Calling#196.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#197.src: You should've picked a more private meeting place! I'm out!
A Hunter's Calling#197.dst: 你們該挑個更隱密的地方碰面的！我走了！
A Hunter's Calling#197.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#200.src: Aah, you're fast! You caught up this quick?! I have no other choice...
A Hunter's Calling#200.dst: 啊，你好快！這麼快就追上來了？！我沒有別的選擇了……
A Hunter's Calling#200.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#201.src: You aren't going to stop me from getting to the battleground! You look like you were scrounged up from rust and verdigris!
A Hunter's Calling#201.dst: 你別想阻止我趕到戰場！你看起來就像是從鏽渣和銅綠裡刮出來的！
A Hunter's Calling#201.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#202.src: Surrender, or I'll use my own mechs to smash you to scrap metal!
A Hunter's Calling#202.dst: 投降，不然我就用我自己的機兵把你砸成廢鐵！
A Hunter's Calling#202.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#203.src: You have defeated both of my most powerful creations...
A Hunter's Calling#203.dst: 你打敗了我最強的兩件造物……
A Hunter's Calling#203.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#204.src: I usually don't do this, but I guess I have no other option. I need to get this information to the others.
A Hunter's Calling#204.dst: 我通常不會這麼做……但我想我沒有別的選擇了。我必須把這個情報送到其他人手上。
A Hunter's Calling#204.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#205.src: No... I... have to tell them.
A Hunter's Calling#205.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#206.src: ...you harden your heart. There is no end, you think.
A Hunter's Calling#206.dst: ……你讓自己的心變硬了。你認為沒有終結。

A Hunter's Calling#207.src: Wrong. The end is in sight.

A Hunter's Calling#208.src: Your soul. It awakens to something new.
A Hunter's Calling#208.dst: 你的靈魂。它正在覺醒成某種新的東西。

A Hunter's Calling#209.src: Not dark. Not light. Not in-between. But separate.
A Hunter's Calling#209.dst: 不是黑暗。不是光明。也不在兩者之間。而是另成一類。

A Hunter's Calling#210.src: Power. Gain. Risk. New beginnings, from an end.
A Hunter's Calling#210.dst: 力量。獲得。風險。新的開始，源自一個終結。

A Hunter's Calling#211.src: So... may we offer you the end?
A Hunter's Calling#211.dst: 那麼……我們可否為你提供那個終結？

A Hunter's Calling#212.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
A Hunter's Calling#212.dst: 最中央的那處……被認為離你的家最近的地方。就在那裡，在 Wynn 的正中央……你將找到那個終結。

A Hunter's Calling#213.src: Halt! Who goes there? Stop, in the name of the {p} army!
A Hunter's Calling#213.dst: 站住！來者何人？站住，以 {p} 軍隊之名！
A Hunter's Calling#213.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#214.src: Should you continue, you shall face the strength and courage of Admiral Aegis!
A Hunter's Calling#214.dst: 你若繼續前進，就得面對 Aegis 上將的力量與勇氣！
A Hunter's Calling#214.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#216.src: We cannot back down against any foe! Chaaaarge!!
A Hunter's Calling#216.dst: 面對任何敵人我們都不能退縮！衝——啊啊！！
A Hunter's Calling#216.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#218.src: Excuse me, I think you're forgetting someone.
A Hunter's Calling#218.dst: 不好意思，我想你們忘了還有人在。

A Hunter's Calling#219.src: {p} will not fall today. We'll be making sure of that!
A Hunter's Calling#219.dst: {p} 今天不會淪陷。我們絕不會讓這種事發生！

A Hunter's Calling#221.src: TASIM! How the hell did you manage to kill him?!
A Hunter's Calling#221.dst: Tasim！你到底是怎麼殺得了他的？！
A Hunter's Calling#221.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#222.dst: 我要把你的內臟扯出來！！
A Hunter's Calling#222.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#223.src: This isn't over! Once your little lackey's dead I'm coming after you!!
A Hunter's Calling#223.dst: 這還沒完！等你那個小跟班死了，我就來找你！！
A Hunter's Calling#223.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#224.src: ...no sense screaming for the dead. But do you think I'm going to just give up like that?
A Hunter's Calling#224.dst: ……對著死人尖叫是沒有用的。不過你以為我會就這樣放棄嗎？
A Hunter's Calling#224.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#225.src: Hah. Didn't know corrupteds had a sense of humor, twisted as it might be.
A Hunter's Calling#225.dst: 哈。沒想到腐敗物也有幽默感，儘管扭曲了點。
A Hunter's Calling#225.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#226.src: I won't dare die while everything here is at stake.
A Hunter's Calling#226.dst: 這裡的一切都危在旦夕，我怎麼敢死。
A Hunter's Calling#226.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#227.src: How's this, then, hm? Think your PEON can handle me at my strongest?
A Hunter's Calling#227.dst: 那這樣如何，嗯？你以為你那個「小嘍囉」應付得了全力以赴的我嗎？
A Hunter's Calling#227.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#229.src: And so, you have reached an end.
A Hunter's Calling#229.dst: 於是，你抵達了一個終結。

A Hunter's Calling#230.src: ???: You wonder. It is an end... But to what...purpose. What will you gain?
A Hunter's Calling#230.dst: ???: 你困惑。這是一個終結……但為了什麼……目的。你將獲得什麼？

A Hunter's Calling#231.src: You have seen loss. Destruction. Betrayal. All ends, to some other than you. Ends that never came to pass...
A Hunter's Calling#231.dst: 你見過失去。毀滅。背叛。全都是終結，屬於你以外的某些人。從未真正發生過的終結……

A Hunter's Calling#232.src: To end is a powerful thing. To find your end... You may never stop searching. You may find your end in but a day's time.
A Hunter's Calling#232.dst: 終結是一件充滿力量的事。要找到你自己的終結……你或許永遠不會停止尋找。你或許在一天之內就找到你的終結。

A Hunter's Calling#233.src: But here... you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#233.dst: 但在這裡……你將獲得帶來終結的力量。也將迎來屬於你的終結。

A Hunter's Calling#234.src: My armies have been sent to the other cities. Their hero is inevitably busy.
A Hunter's Calling#234.dst: 我的軍隊已被派往其他城市。他們的英雄必然分身乏術。

A Hunter's Calling#235.src: Hm... Ah, hello there! Good to see you around, recruit. Is there anything you needed?
A Hunter's Calling#235.dst: 嗯……啊，你好！很高興在這裡見到你，新兵。有什麼需要嗎？

A Hunter's Calling#236.src: After the King of {p} ordered the slums cave-in, another war broke out.
A Hunter's Calling#236.dst: {p} 國王下令讓貧民窟坍塌之後，又爆發了一場戰爭。

A Hunter's Calling#237.src: Yellow Beacons are pretty common, and they're great if you want to maximize your net loot throughout your run!
A Hunter's Calling#237.dst: 黃色信標很常見，如果你想在整趟 Lootrun 中盡量多拿戰利品，它們非常好用！

A Hunter's Calling#239.src: However. Though the change is irrevocable...
A Hunter's Calling#239.dst: 然而。儘管這份改變無可挽回……

A Hunter's Calling#240.src: The power to bring an end. It is a choice. And that... Whether you will use that power, we cannot tell you.
A Hunter's Calling#240.dst: 帶來終結的力量。那是一個選擇。而那……你是否會使用那份力量，我們無法告訴你。

A Hunter's Calling#241.src: You must deign to take that choice.
A Hunter's Calling#241.dst: 你必須自己屈身接下那個選擇。

A Hunter's Calling#242.src: We may offer you not one more end.
A Hunter's Calling#242.dst: 我們無法再為你提供任何一個終結。

A Hunter's Calling#243.src: You must find your final end yourself. We will remain... And offer others the same. And so...
A Hunter's Calling#243.dst: 你必須自己找到你最終的終結。我們會留下……並向其他人提供同樣的東西。於是……

A Hunter's Calling#245.src: ???: But here...you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#245.dst: ???: 但在這裡……你將獲得帶來終結的力量。也將迎來屬於你的終結。

A Hunter's Calling#246.src: We destroy {p} today. The great fortress will fall.
A Hunter's Calling#246.dst: 今天，我們要摧毀 {p}。那座偉大的要塞將會陷落。
A Hunter's Calling#246.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#247.src: I will find their protector, Bob. You each will engage the guards and city dwellers. {~} citizens.
A Hunter's Calling#247.dst: 我會去找他們的守護者，Bob。你們各自去對付守衛與城裡的居民。{~} 名市民。
A Hunter's Calling#247.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#248.src: If each of you kills {~} citizens, then the city will run empty. So, you shall make it run empty.
A Hunter's Calling#248.dst: 只要你們每個人殺掉 {~} 名市民，這座城就會變成空城。所以，你們就讓它變成空城。
A Hunter's Calling#248.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#250.src: When the armies of {p} reached the once noble fort, it was corrupted ashes.
A Hunter's Calling#250.dst: 當 {p} 的軍隊抵達那座曾經高貴的堡壘時，那裡只剩下腐敗的灰燼。

A Hunter's Calling#251.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning...to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#251.dst: 不義者尋求它。高潔者藏起它。尋求答案的人找到了更多問題。另一個開始……通向一個新的終結。

A Hunter's Calling#252.src: Head to town and get further information from the employee.
A Hunter's Calling#252.dst: 前往鎮上，向員工取得進一步的情報。

A Hunter's Calling#253.src: Head to the northern part of the bank and find a way up to the ceiling.
A Hunter's Calling#253.dst: 前往銀行的北側，找到通往天花板的路。

A Hunter's Calling#254.src: Make sure to break the anvil trap before breaking the fences and escaping the area
A Hunter's Calling#254.dst: 打破柵欄、逃離這一帶之前，記得先破壞鐵砧陷阱

A Hunter's Calling#255.src: The humans didn't notice any difference after the new laws, but the company was in full force...
A Hunter's Calling#255.dst: 新法上路後，人們並沒有察覺任何不同，但公司早已全力運作……

A Hunter's Calling#256.src: I send you in my place. He will expect me. He will not expect one that looks as human as you.
A Hunter's Calling#256.dst: 我派你代替我去。他會預料到我。但他不會預料到一個看起來像你這麼像人類的傢伙。
A Hunter's Calling#256.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#257.src: If you fail, it will set us back greatly. It will give them a chance. Do not let them get that chance.
A Hunter's Calling#257.dst: 要是你失敗了，我們會大幅倒退。那會給他們一個機會。別讓他們得到那個機會。
A Hunter's Calling#257.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#260.src: Do you wish to go back to battle Theorick from A Hunter's Calling again?
A Hunter's Calling#260.dst: 要回去再次挑戰 A Hunter's Calling 的 Theorick 嗎？

A Hunter's Calling#261.src: Because of Theorick's passing, {p} never was saved.
A Hunter's Calling#261.dst: 由於 Theorick 的死，{p} 終究沒能得救。

A Hunter's Calling#262.src: The corruption fully took over the town and its citizens.
A Hunter's Calling#262.dst: 腐敗徹底吞沒了這座城鎮與它的居民。

A Hunter's Calling#263.src: The Twains fall away. The peon has done its job well.
A Hunter's Calling#263.dst: Twain 一家就此消逝。那個走卒把工作做得很好。
A Hunter's Calling#263.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#264.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world...in some fashion.
A Hunter's Calling#264.dst: 一個終結，被更多的行動所驅逐。一個終結，降臨於六者。一個終結，屬於傲慢者的篤定。一個終結，屬於這個世界……以某種形式。
A Hunter's Calling#264.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#265.src: Peon. You have been created for one purpose. You will ensure the fall of {p}.
A Hunter's Calling#265.dst: 小嘍囉。你被造出來只為了一件事。你要確保 {p} 陷落。
A Hunter's Calling#265.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#266.src: The Corrupter of Worlds was trapped within this cave. The fool decimated my army when I laid siege last.
A Hunter's Calling#266.dst: 世界腐敗者被困在這座洞窟裡。上次我發動圍攻時，那個蠢貨把我的軍隊殺得七零八落。
A Hunter's Calling#266.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#267.src: Since then, it has been sealed in. The magic of the Twains is strong here. It cannot escape.
A Hunter's Calling#267.dst: 從那之後，他就被封印在裡面。Twain 一家的魔法在這裡很強。他逃不出去。
A Hunter's Calling#267.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#268.src: You will release it from this cave. Whether you die afterwards is irrelevant. It will destroy {p} of its own accord.
A Hunter's Calling#268.dst: 你要把他從這座洞窟裡放出來。之後你是死是活無關緊要。他會自己去摧毀 {p}。
A Hunter's Calling#268.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#269.src: Venture through the cave. Break the Twains' seal. And ensure it has a way to escape.
A Hunter's Calling#269.dst: 穿過洞窟。打破 Twain 一家的封印。然後確保他有路可以逃出來。
A Hunter's Calling#269.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#270.src: Defend yourself. It is too far gone to control. You will be attacked.
A Hunter's Calling#270.dst: 保護好你自己。他已經失控到無法駕馭了。你會遭到攻擊。
A Hunter's Calling#270.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#272.src: The roaring of the Corrupter of Worlds is audible from here. Has it noticed you?
A Hunter's Calling#272.dst: 從這裡就聽得到世界腐敗者的咆哮。他察覺到你了嗎？

A Hunter's Calling#273.src: I do not have the time to create another peon for this job. Do not fail.
A Hunter's Calling#273.dst: 我沒時間再為這件差事造一個走卒。別失敗。
A Hunter's Calling#273.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#274.src: The Corrupteds are malleable. Create some kind of bridge with them. Answer how for yourself.
A Hunter's Calling#274.dst: 那些腐敗物可以任意塑形。用他們搭出某種橋。怎麼做，你自己想。
A Hunter's Calling#274.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#276.src: The Corrupter is awake. And it is close. Move, peon! You still must break the seal.
A Hunter's Calling#276.dst: 腐敗者醒了。而且就在附近。快走，小嘍囉！你還得打破封印。
A Hunter's Calling#276.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#277.src: I am unfamiliar with Twain magic. Use the intellect I have given you. Break the seal.
A Hunter's Calling#277.dst: 我不熟悉 Twain 一家的魔法。運用我賦予你的智慧。打破封印。
A Hunter's Calling#277.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#278.src: Your job is done... And you survived. I will save you for another mission, should I need you. Now...watch.
A Hunter's Calling#278.dst: 你的工作完成了……而且你活下來了。要是我還需要你，就留你去做下一個任務。現在……看著吧。
A Hunter's Calling#278.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#279.src: Maybe you can create a trail of emeralds and lure the villager back to the factory?
A Hunter's Calling#279.dst: 也許可以用綠寶石鋪一條路，把村民引回工廠？

A Hunter's Calling#280.src: You should finish escorting your current companion before talking to someone else!
A Hunter's Calling#280.dst: 先把目前的同伴護送完，再去找別人說話吧！

A Hunter's Calling#281.src: Just get me to {p} or a doctor or even a sink!
A Hunter's Calling#281.dst: 帶我去 {p}，或者找個醫生，甚至只要有個水槽也好！
A Hunter's Calling#281.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#282.src: Maybe you can lure the villager by flirting?
A Hunter's Calling#282.dst: 也許可以靠搭訕把村民引過去？
A Hunter's Calling#282.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#283.src: Heya, again. Thinking of it, a lovely one like you is probably spoken for already, huh?
A Hunter's Calling#283.dst: 嗨，又見面了。想想也是，像你這麼可愛的人，大概早就名花有主了吧？
A Hunter's Calling#283.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#284.src: Guess I'll just go pick some flowers for myself.
A Hunter's Calling#284.dst: 看來我只好自己去摘點花了。
A Hunter's Calling#284.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#285.src: But this time, it was between Dwarves and Dwarves... And yet again blood was spilled.
A Hunter's Calling#285.dst: 但這一次，是矮人與矮人之間的戰爭……鮮血再一次流淌。

A Hunter's Calling#289.dst: 目標: 清除 Avos 的存在。
A Hunter's Calling#289.speaker: Corkus Guard

A Hunter's Calling#290.src: Maxie never made it back to the war scene. The civil war advanced faster than anyone could have anticipated.
A Hunter's Calling#290.dst: Maxie 終究沒能回到戰場。內戰推進的速度，遠超過任何人的預料。

A Hunter's Calling#291.src: The once peaceful Avos were forced to flee their home island, ravaged by machines and toxic scrap...
A Hunter's Calling#291.dst: 曾經愛好和平的 Avos，被迫逃離遭機械與有毒廢料蹂躪的家鄉島嶼……

A Hunter's Calling#292.src: In time, Corkus became known as the island torn apart by war. Its name would live on in infamy.
A Hunter's Calling#292.dst: 久而久之，Corkus 成了人們口中被戰爭撕裂的島嶼。它的名字將永遠背負惡名。

A Hunter's Calling#293.src: {p}. What a foolish place for a central trading town, so close to the Roots.
A Hunter's Calling#293.dst: {p}。把貿易重鎮建在這種地方，離 Roots 這麼近，真是愚蠢。
A Hunter's Calling#293.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#294.src: You will destroy the guards. I will destroy the town.
A Hunter's Calling#294.dst: 你去摧毀守衛。我來摧毀城鎮。
A Hunter's Calling#294.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#296.src: The strongest of {p}' army is dead. The rest are hiding in fear. {p} will fall.
A Hunter's Calling#296.dst: {p} 軍中最強的人已經死了。其餘的都躲起來發抖。{p} 將會陷落。
A Hunter's Calling#296.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#297.src: Self-confident idiots. I won't even bother dealing with you two.
A Hunter's Calling#297.dst: 自以為是的蠢貨。我連跟你們兩個周旋都懶得。
A Hunter's Calling#297.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#299.dst: 小嘍囉。去收拾這場鬧劇。
A Hunter's Calling#299.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#300.src: You take too much stock in your ability. My victory is inevitable.
A Hunter's Calling#300.dst: 你太高估自己的能耐了。我的勝利是必然的。
A Hunter's Calling#300.speaker: Bak'al

A Hunter's Calling#301.src: It stood as a monument to wealth, prosperity, and power in the Wynn province. It now stands as a corrupted wasteland.
A Hunter's Calling#301.dst: 它曾是 Wynn 行省財富、繁榮與權力的象徵。如今它只是一片腐敗的荒地。

A Hunter's Calling#302.src: The ruins of the city are a grim reminder of the power of corruption. And so...the people began to lose hope.
A Hunter's Calling#302.dst: 這座城市的廢墟，殘酷地提醒著人們腐敗的力量。於是……人們開始失去希望。

A Hunter's Calling#303.src: You have gained the power to end. You have unlocked The Hunted Mode.
A Hunter's Calling#303.dst: 你獲得了終結的力量。你已解鎖 The Hunted Mode。
